methodology_steps.name: EDA-to-ML Contract
methodology_steps.purpose: Re-encode EDA findings as column contracts.
methodology_steps.insight: Drop City/Ad Topic Line; target-encode Country; parse Timestamp.

methodology_steps.name: Stratified Train/Test Split (80/20)
methodology_steps.purpose: Hold out 200 rows for final evaluation.
methodology_steps.insight: Stratify preserves the 50/50 class balance in both splits.

methodology_steps.name: Timestamp Feature Engineering
methodology_steps.purpose: Convert unique datetimes to cyclic hour/dow/month signals.
methodology_steps.insight: Cyclic sin/cos encoding avoids the artificial discontinuity at midnight.

methodology_steps.name: Preprocessing Pipelines
methodology_steps.insight: Trees are scale-invariant; StandardScaler only applied to the linear branch.

methodology_steps.name: 5-Fold Stratified CV on 3 Models
methodology_steps.purpose: Compare LR, Random Forest, and HistGBT on CV ROC-AUC.
methodology_steps.insight: 5 folds give 160 val rows per fold — stable for 1,000-row data.

methodology_steps.name: Hyperparameter Tuning (RandomizedSearchCV)
methodology_steps.purpose: Search 40 random configs on the CV winner.
methodology_steps.insight: Random search explores the space more uniformly than grid search for the same budget.

methodology_steps.name: Held-out Evaluation
methodology_steps.purpose: Score 8 metrics on the untouched test set.
methodology_steps.insight: ROC-AUC > 0.98 indicates near-perfect rank ordering of click probability.

methodology_steps.name: Calibration (Isotonic Regression)
methodology_steps.purpose: Check if predicted probabilities match observed click rates; apply fix if Brier improves >= 5%.
methodology_steps.insight: Calibrated probabilities enable reliable expected-value calculations.

methodology_steps.name: Threshold Tuning
methodology_steps.purpose: Sweep threshold 0.01-0.99; pick t that maximises F1.

methodology_steps.name: Learning Curve Diagnostic
methodology_steps.purpose: Plot train vs. val AUC as training set grows.
methodology_steps.insight: Converging curves with small gap indicate the model is near its capacity ceiling.

methodology_steps.name: Permutation Importance
methodology_steps.purpose: Mean drop in test ROC-AUC when each feature is randomly shuffled.
methodology_steps.insight: Daily Internet Usage and Daily Time Spent dominate; Country/Male contribute negligibly.

methodology_steps.name: SHAP Explanations
methodology_steps.insight: Low internet usage strongly pushes predictions toward click=1.

methodology_steps.name: Error Slice Analysis
methodology_steps.insight: Young users (18-28) and high-internet-usage users show the largest AUC gap vs. global.

eda_to_ml_decisions.eda_finding: Ad Topic Line cardinality=1.0 (unique per row)
eda_to_ml_decisions.ml_action: Drop — acts as a row identifier, leaks nothing.
Drop — would cause severe overfitting if encoded.
Target-encode with out-of-fold CV inside the pipeline to avoid leakage.
Parse to hour, dayofweek, month + cyclic sin/cos of hour — drop raw column.

eda_to_ml_decisions.eda_finding: Wide scale differences (Area Income ~10^4 vs Male in {0,1})
eda_to_ml_decisions.ml_action: StandardScaler on numeric branch of the linear pipeline; passthrough for trees.

eda_to_ml_decisions.eda_finding: Moderate Daily Time x Daily Internet Usage correlation (r~0.52)
eda_to_ml_decisions.ml_action: L2 regularisation in Logistic Regression (C tuned) to handle mild multicollinearity.

eda_to_ml_decisions.eda_finding: Zero missing values and zero duplicates
eda_to_ml_decisions.ml_action: Median imputer wired as a safety net for future data drift — never fires on current data.
No class weights, no SMOTE — balanced data makes accuracy a valid headline metric.
